0x544ea103.notice: Seeds access control, the ERC-20 share metadata, the ERC-4626 vault params, and VaultCore.

params.admin_: The account granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (may set the strategy manager).
params.asset_: The underlying ERC-20 asset the vault holds.
params.decimalsOffset_: Virtual-share decimals offset for inflation-attack mitigation (usually 0).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a VaultCore diamond — an ERC-4626 vault extended with strategy hooks. Runs the module initializers in dependency order inside a single initializing window: AccessControl (grants `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` to `admin`, gating strategy-manager changes), ERC-20 (share metadata), ERC-4626 (underlying asset + offset), then VaultCore (registers IVaultCore via ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window — it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open.
